author: Steve Wallis
description:
I went out camping in a busy little area in the small town of Chemainus, BC. It was a lovely night with a very comfortable inflatable bed! I normally stealth camp with a hammock or under a tarp with a sleeping pad, but my shoulder has been causing me distress, and I decided it was worth the "unstealthy" equipment addition. Camo netting around the campsite gave me pretty good camouflage. I toured the town and even went out for a pint at the pub across the road. Very nice campsite and great night of late summer adventure.
